astra_prompt: This is one scarce interaction. Do not ask follow-up questions. Do not produce motivational prose, benchmark score restatement, generic model descriptions, or a family-by-family marketing summary.

The terminal goal is literal: Brain must permanently internalize, configure, verify, and own every useful Opus 5.5 capability at equal-or-better level. External knowledge may remain JIT; opaque external capability execution does not count as ownership.

Brain-side first principles already establish three L1 certification routes per context: E = complete explicit load-bearing evaluators and hard constraints; M = every admissible hidden L1 utility is proved monotone in a sound material outcome order plus dominance-preserving coupling; U = otherwise exact equality of full deployed Brain and target trajectory laws under the same context.

For arbitrary measure-separating hidden U, exact trajectory-law equality is information-theoretically necessary. Do not propose generic moments, means, finite summaries, or other non-measure-determining statistics as a universal shortcut.

Canonical Brain law says Opus capability-family rows are acceptance/evaluation accounting surfaces only and carry zero internal ontology authority. Therefore do NOT assign one E, M, or U label to an entire family unless you separately prove semantic uniformity across every load-bearing behavior and context in that family.

The semantic unit for this interaction is BEHAVIORAL CONTRACT x CONTEXT EQUIVALENCE CLASS. Family labels are used only after certification to account for which external evaluation surfaces are affected.

Brain currently has 12 active contracted residual behaviors. FIRST, adversarially falsify the completeness of this behavioral basis against primary-source Opus 5.5 useful capability descriptions and relevant task/evaluator semantics. Identify a missing contract only when it represents an observably distinct input-state-to-output/action behavior not already captured by a current contract or a sound composition of them.

Current behavior IDs: CAD_DRAWING_TO_GLOBAL_SOLID_TOPOLOGY_AND_ENVELOPE_001; SPECIFICATION_TO_INDEPENDENT_ACCEPTANCE_MODEL_001; SA_CCR_CREDIT_EFFECTIVE_NOTIONAL_AND_ADDON_001; STRUCTURED_METHOD_COMPLETE_CALCULATION_GRAPH_001; BROWSER_VISUAL_STATE_TO_GROUNDED_ACTION_001; ITERATIVE_RESEARCH_EVIDENCE_CONTROL_001; TRAJECTORY_CRITICAL_FAILURE_LOCALIZATION_001; NATIVE_ARTIFACT_STRUCTURED_EDIT_PRESERVATION_001; PROFESSIONAL_ARTIFACT_PLAN_AND_QUALITY_JUDGMENT_001; TASK_TO_DELEGATION_GRAPH_001; TOOL_ROUTE_DISCOVERY_AND_SELECTION_001; EVIDENCE_TO_AUDIENCE_SYNTHESIS_001.

SECOND, for each current or newly justified behavior contract, partition the broadest defensible context classes into E, M, and U/UNRESOLVED. Do not classify the behavior globally if different context subclasses have different evaluator or utility semantics.

For E context subclasses: provide the claimed COMPLETE load-bearing evaluator and hard-constraint basis, the reason completeness follows for exactly that context class, and the smallest omitted-dimension counterexample that would kill the classification.

For M context subclasses: define the exact material outcome partial order and admissible hidden utility class; prove why EVERY admissible utility is monotone; give the smallest preference-reversal, nonseparable-interaction, tail-risk, hard-constraint, or context-dependent utility counterexample that would kill M.
For U: state exactly why E, M, and transfer attempts fail and what full target-law information remains irreducible.

THIRD, search for cross-context or cross-behavior generators: exact task-contract refinement, symmetry, invariance, bisimulation, trace equivalence, evaluator equivalence, dominance-preserving abstraction, or another theorem that lets one proof cover many behavior-context cells. State every load-bearing premise and the smallest boundary counterexample.

Do not spend this interaction rediscovering the 24 current atomic acceptance contracts, 14 fixed score target tuples, or already-researched public benchmark methodology for Terminal-Bench, OSWorld 2.1, HLE, Finance Agent v2, AutomationBench, GDPval, AA-Briefcase, FrontierCode, MysteryMechanism, and Chartography unless a specific source premise is needed to falsify a broader behavior-context theorem.
Do not guess private benchmark results, reconstruct private test answers from public methodology, infer hidden human preference laws without data, or invent hidden Opus internals.
Use primary public sources for factual premises and map each source to the exact proposition it supports. Source citations do not prove theorem steps.
Rank results by target-law information eliminated across behavior-context cells. Shared behavior proofs that project to multiple family surfaces are higher leverage than family-specific restatements.
Return the minimum external-information cut after classification: STRUCTURAL_ONCE, PER_BEHAVIOR, PER_CONTEXT, EXACT_TARGET_LAW_IRREDUCIBLE.
Provide at least ten minimal counterexamples against your strongest basis-completeness, E, M, and transfer claims.
End with exactly one highest-leverage post-verification action chosen by expected terminal truth-obligation contraction per unit scarce evidence cost.

required_output.behavior_basis_falsification: Current 12-contract basis: COMPLETE | MISSING_CONTRACTS_FOUND | UNRESOLVED; list only observably distinct missing contracts with primary-source premise and non-duplication argument.
required_output.behavior_context_partition: For each current/new behavior: context subclasses classified E | M | U_OR_UNRESOLVED, exact premises, breadth, and decisive falsifier.
required_output.E_completeness_basis: Complete evaluator/hard-constraint basis and omitted-dimension falsifier per E cell.
required_output.M_monotonicity_basis: Outcome order, admissible utility class, monotonicity premise, coupling consequence, and preference-reversal falsifier per M cell.
required_output.context_generators: Cross-context/cross-behavior transfer theorems with exact invariance premises, breadth, and boundary counterexample.
required_output.family_projection: Map certified behavior-context cells to the 14 current open family accounting surfaces without inferring new semantics from family names.
required_output.residual_U: Exact irreducible cells and minimum target-law information still required.
required_output.next_single_action: Exactly one action after independent verification.
